// diagnostic

E0385

This declaration uses the retired `name: Type = value` default spelling.

What

This declaration uses the retired `name: Type = value` default spelling.

Why

Declaration defaults ride the type as `name: Type{{value}}`; `=` remains for reassignment and extern slot fill.

Fix

Write `name: Type{{value}}` for a declaration default, or keep `=` for reassignment and extern slot fill.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0385: tests/ui/default_shape_retired.stderr.
